timestamps.description: Timestamps related to a spec's lifecycle, separated by source system. Cerve timestamps are managed automatically by Cerve's system. Supplier timestamps reflect when the spec data was originally created or last updated by the supplier (i.e. the source of the product information).

supplier.description: Timestamps reflecting when the supplier originally authored or last modified the product information. Useful for determining data freshness and sending suppliers reminders when their data is outdated.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the spec data was originally created by the supplier. Null if not provided by the supplier.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the spec data was last updated by the supplier. Null if not provided by the supplier.

supplier_id.description: The supplier ID of the supplier of the product

oneOf.description: Unique identifier of the supplier
